name: Rue des Gestes — étape 8 · filer, renverser, clore
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (ginger cat dashing off with a fish fillet, shaggy dog knocking over the milk pail, raccoon hanging up the telephone on the balcony, king holding out his crown to renounce it at the upper window), -ir/-re RIGHT (big red crab pushing its door shut with a claw; man flinging his shutters open again at the upper window). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
